notes:
A full bank of pistons wraps back to 1 when the piece is not using memory levels.

**On a piece with no memory level, the piston after the last general goes back to 1 — still with no memory level.** It used to roll over to "level 2", inventing a memory level in a piece you are deliberately keeping off them. That is for temporary pieces that you re-register each time rather than commit to a level, and wrapping round is what you do at the console.

Pieces that do use memory levels are unchanged: after the last general on a level, the next piston goes to number 1 on the next level, as before.

After wrapping it carries on in order — 1, 2, 3 — rather than handing out 1 again and again, even though those numbers are already on the page.

The same fix applies to an organ set up with no memory levels at all, which used to stop at its last number and repeat it.

Also in 2.08 if you missed it: the tool you pick now survives a dropped message.
